description:
"Unleash a swarm of fetcherflies to relentlessly attack an enemy, causing them to bleed for |cffffff15730|r Bleed Damage over |cffffff20|r seconds. 

The fetcherflies rip through the original enemy's flesh, afflicting them with Minor Vulnerability for the duration, increasing their damage taken by |cffffff5|r%.

Enemies near the carrier take |cffffff1516|r Bleed Damage every |cffffff2|r seconds for the duration.

You can only have one Growing Swarm active at a time."
